description: This Java class implements a provider for bootstrap configuration tasks in a LwM2M (Lightweight M2M) context, managing bootstrap sessions, creating requests, and handling security and server object instances.

classes.name: LwM2MBootstrapConfigStoreTaskProvider
classes.description: Implements bootstrap task provider managing bootstrap sessions, creating requests, and handling security and server object instances.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Generates bootstrap tasks based on session state and previous responses, initiating discovery if needed.

methods.name: shouldStartWithDiscover
methods.description: Determines if bootstrap should start with a discovery request based on configuration.

methods.name: findInstancesIdOldByServerId
methods.description: Processes discover response to find server object instances and map them by short server ID.

methods.name: initAfterBootstrapDiscover
methods.description: Initializes supported objects and version info after a bootstrap discover response.

methods.name: toRequests
methods.description: Creates a list of bootstrap downlink requests for security, server, and ACL objects based on configuration.

methods.name: initSupportedObjectsDefault
methods.description: Initializes default supported objects and their versions.

methods.name: validateLwm2mShortServerId
methods.description: Validates if a short server ID is within the acceptable range.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes session client data for a given endpoint.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Initializes session client data for a given endpoint.
